ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the certainty of the Resurrection in Surah Al-Inshiqaq?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the absolute certainty of the Ma'ad (Resurrection), affirming that no soul will be absent from the divine reckoning. It serves as a powerful reminder of individual accountability, reinforcing the belief that the Day of Judgment is an inevitable reality for all humanity, regardless of their denial.
